title: Advanced Topics
description: Cursors, conditional expressions, null handling, dynamic SQL, deadlocks, looping, and flow control.
longDescription: This module covers advanced SQL Server topics including cursors for row-by-row processing, conditional expressions (CASE, COALESCE, NULLIF), dynamic SQL, deadlock handling, and flow control statements (WHILE, BREAK, CONTINUE).
whatYouLearn: Use cursors for row-by-row processing of result sets
Create and manage temporary tables and table variables
Use CASE, COALESCE, and NULLIF expressions for conditional logic
Construct dynamic SQL statements using sp_executesql
Use WHILE loops with BREAK and CONTINUE for flow control
